what: The sensitivity criterion MI-278 U18 introduced — impute the unnameable rows at both extremes and require the SIGN to survive the worst case — invents no alpha and is therefore also insensitive to n. Measured on U18's own population at a package denominator it PASSES on a comparison whose two-sided Fisher p is 0.1984, by a margin of 0.0044. The two criteria disagree, and a reader taking either alone reaches a confident answer the other contradicts.
